View the dry well for the first time
The dry well has been checked
maps.points.caerlin_woods.detail-12: Rewards Golden Coins ×8 (Option "Check the well edge and masonry." held) Pickaxe, Those who have not yet obtained what is in the well Golden Coins)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.detail-13: Roots coil around an old stone altar. Moss hides most of the carvings.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.detail-15: The birch trees open into a quiet glade. Yellow leaves drift in slow spirals through the air.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.detail-16: At (18, -21) Stepped on by the party
maps.points.caerlin_woods.detail-18: The Whispering Tree stands silent, your name carved into its bark.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.detail-2: At (-1, -26) Stepped on by the party
maps.points.caerlin_woods.detail-20:
Examine the names carved into the bark.
Carve your own name.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.detail-21: You kneel beside a patch of soft mud. Fresh wolf tracks cut between the roots, almost invisible beneath fallen leaves.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.detail-22:
The party steps on the tile at (21, -27).
The party steps on the tile at (21, -27) with a ranger in the party.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.detail-24: The statue stands whole once more, her wolves watchful at her feet.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.detail-26: Place it there The head of the wolf. (Hold it.) Wolf Skull)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.detail-27:
Repaired statue
Statue not yet repaired
maps.points.caerlin_woods.detail-28: As you make your way through the forest, your thief spots something hidden under the brush.

The party steps on the tile at (21, -43).
The party steps on the tile at (10, -41).
maps.points.caerlin_woods.detail-30:
Party member required: Thief
There are no thieves in the team
maps.points.caerlin_woods.detail-31: Caerlin Woods rises ahead, pine trees dripping with rain. The ground is soft, the air cold, and every breath carries the scent of damp soil.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.detail-32: The tile at (8, -19) activates when the party steps on it or an object holds it down.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.detail-34: Talk with Michael at the ancient tree in the forest (-3, -47), and choose "Agree to engrave his name."
maps.points.caerlin_woods.detail-4: Something moves between the distant trees.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.detail-5: The tile at (26, -31) activates when the party steps on it or an object holds it down.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.detail-6:
The team has no Echo Sight
Party member required: Echo Sight
maps.points.caerlin_woods.detail-7: Receive Echo Charm(Option "Echo Vision") The team has Echo Vision
maps.points.caerlin_woods.detail-8: An old stone well stands crooked among the roots. The rope rotted away long ago. No bucket. No surface water. Only a black throat dropping into the earth. What are you going to do?
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue: The rain fades as you reach a small clearing. A dead fire pit, broken crates, and the scattered remains of a camp lie abandoned in the mud.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-10: They vanish at the threshold, blurred by rain and time. "Someone went in. No one came out."
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-100: The darkness seems to listen as the coin falls.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-101: "MANY HAVE FED ME. FEW SO GENEROUSLY."
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-102: The shaft answers with a hollow echo.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-104: The coin vanishes into the black.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-106: A faint breath rises from below.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-108: The darkness seems almost pleased now.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-110: The coin falls for a very long time.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-111: "PERHAPS THE NEXT ONE WILL BE LUCKY."
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-112: The echo returns almost immediately this time.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-113: Select “Toss a coin into the shaft” / “Toss a coin into the shaft” (Insufficient gold coins: 1 gold coin)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-114: You pat your pockets. No coin remains.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-115: Choose “Toss a coin into the shaft” (Fewer than 1 gold coins)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-116: You search your purse, but find nothing.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-117: No coin. Only the darkness below.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-118: You have nothing left to throw.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-119: Choose “Inspect the rim and masonry.” (Possession of Ho, Have not received any gold coins from the well yet)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-12: You close your eyes and let your senses widen.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-120: The mortar is crumbly. With a few careful pries of the pick, a loose stone comes free. Behind it, a niche big enough for a hand.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-122: You pull out a small coin pouch, heavy with gold.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-123: Choose “Inspect the rim and masonry.” (Lack of Ho, Have not received any gold coins from the well yet)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-124: An old iron ring is set into the stone. A rope was once tied here, worn grooves still visible in the rock.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-125: Choose “Inspect the rim and masonry.” (You have already obtained the gold coins from the well)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-126: Two chalices rest upon it: one wooden, filled with a faint green liquid, and one golden, empty.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-127: The altar is quiet now, its chalices empty and cold.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-128: There is nothing more to do here.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-129: The altar lies cracked and broken. Its carvings have lost their glow.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-13: Multiple magical traces linger here, tangled together like threads in a torn tapestry.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-130: The glade holds no more answers.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-131: The altar waits. The two chalices remain unchanged.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-132: The altar waits. Clear water now fills the golden chalice. The wooden chalice still holds its faint green glow.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-133: Place coins into the golden chalice.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-134: Pour water into the golden chalice. (once only)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-135: Offer food into the golden chalice.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-136: Drink from the glowing chalice. (once only)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-14: You are not able to say where they lead.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-140: You tip the wooden chalice, spilling its glowing liquid across the altar stones.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-141: The light hisses as it touches the moss. Roots snap upward, twisting in fury.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-143: You overturn the golden chalice. Clear water spills across the altar and sinks into the roots below.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-144: The forest falls silent for a heartbeat. Then the roots begin to writhe beneath the stone.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-148: Choose “Place coins into the golden chalice.”
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-149: How much gold will you offer?
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-153: Choose “Drop a single coin.” (Have at least 1 gold coin)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-154: A single coin vanishes. The chalice remains empty. The roots around the altar begin to twitch.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-155: Choose “Drop a single coin.” (Fewer than 1 gold coins)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-156: You have no coin to give.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-157: Choose “Pour five coins.” (Have at least 5 gold coins)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-158: Five coins vanish into the chalice. For a moment, faint ripples stir across its surface, then fade. The trees answer with a low, angry creak.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-159: Choose “Pour five coins.” (Fewer than 5 gold coins)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-16: Blood magic dominates the view and it spills from both caves.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-161: Choose “Pour ten coins.” (Have at least 10 gold coins)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-162: Ten coins cascade into the chalice. They vanish like mist, and clear water rises in their place.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-163: Choose “Pour ten coins.” (Fewer than 10 gold coins)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-164: Choose “Drink from the glowing chalice.” (Depends on story progress)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-165: Who will drink from the chalice?
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-167: You drink from the wooden chalice. Sweetness floods your mouth, followed by a cold sting spreading through your veins.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-168: Your body changes in subtle ways. You can already feel the forest's gift taking root within you.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-169: You drink from the wooden chalice. It tastes sweet at first, then sharp and cold, like biting into frozen roots.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-17: Yet another faint current drifts northward, deeper into the forest.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-170: Your body answers in small, unfamiliar ways. The forest's gift has taken root.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-172: You raise the golden chalice and drink. The water turns bitter in your mouth. A sharp pain spreads through your body as something beneath your skin begins to change.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-173: As if that was not enough, the forest around you begins to awaken in anger. Roots twist beneath the altar.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-174: Choose “Pour water into the golden chalice.”
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-175: You pour water into the golden chalice. It seeps away without trace. The roots beneath the altar begin to move.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-176: Choose “Offer food into the golden chalice.” (Depends on story progress)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-177: You place food inside. It blackens to ash in seconds.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-178: Somewhere in the forest, wood creaks in anger.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-179: You carry no food to offer.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-18: Event opening (The team has no Echo Sight)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-180: The altar cracks. Bark splits, vines coil upward, and green-black sap seeps between the stones.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-181: A dryad is formed from the ruin, her gaze cold and merciless.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-183: You step back, leaving the altar as it is.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-184: The birch trees open into a quiet glade. Yellow leaves drift in slow spirals through the air.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-185: At its center stands a moss-covered stone altar, pale roots wrapped around its sides.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-186: Then a whisper slips through the branches above.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-188: Then falls silent, save for the wind whispering through the branches.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-19: When you blink, it is gone.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-195: You close your eyes and let the forest in. The glade is not quiet. It is listening.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-196: Every root, leaf, and branch feels awake. One careless act could turn this place against you.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-197: "Careful," you whisper. "This whole place is alive."
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-199: You narrow your eyes and let infra sight settle. No heat, no shapes. Nothing alive on the altar or in the trees.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-2: Bootprints scar the ground, circling and fading as they trail toward two narrow caves.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-20: Event opening (Party member required: Echo Sight)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-202: You reach out for any trace of spellcraft, but the air is empty. No wards, no residue, nothing binding the shimmer.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-205: You inspect the approach to the altar, along with the roots and stones around it, but find no traps or hidden mechanisms.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-207: You scan the soft ground around the altar. Apart from rabbit tracks, nothing disturbed the glade recently.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-208: Something beyond the trees seems to follow your every movement, but you are unable to say if it is just a feeling.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-209: The forest is quiet. The binding is complete.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-21: Echo Sight catches vibrations where none should exist.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-210: The tree bears the fresh cuts of your carving, the name 'Michael' etched for the fourth and final time.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-211: Whatever truth was bound to that name, it is clear now he was not the man he claimed to be.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-212: Michael is gone without a trace, and the last chance to carve your own name into the bark has slipped away.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-213: The Whispering Tree stands alone now. The bark is nearly filled, only a sliver of space left.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-214: The tree's bark is rough, scarred by dozens of carved names. Layer upon layer, some fresh, others nearly lost to age.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-215: So many are carved here that only a narrow patch of space remains, barely enough for one more name.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-216: As you study the scars, the undergrowth rustles. Someone is pushing through the brush nearby.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-217: A gaunt man in a patched green cloak emerges from the bushes. His boots are muddy, his face pale and tired. Despite his shabby appearance, he greets you with a confident smile.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-218: "Michael," he says, introducing himself without hesitation.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-22: A pale silhouette stands among the trees, barely visible. Not alive. A ghost.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-220: "There must be a secret in this tree. I can feel it. But it won't answer me... maybe it will answer you."
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-221: "Carve my name, will you? I'll make it worth your time."
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-223: Hold. Where did you come from? (once only)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-224: Why don't you carve it yourself? (once only)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-225: Agree to carve his name. (once only)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-226: Refuse. You won't carve his name.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-227: Examine the names carved into the bark. (Depending on the progression of the story, only once)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-228: "You didn't just wander in here." (Party member required: Thief, Available once)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-229: Choose “Hold. Where did you come from?”
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-23: The forest around it falls silent.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-230: "Nowhere special," he says lightly. "The forest paths are free to walk, eh?"
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-231: Choose “You didn't just wander in here.”
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-232: You study his stance, the way he keeps one shoulder angled toward the brush.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-233: He did not stumble into this clearing. He positioned himself here.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-234: Choose “Why don't you carve it yourself?”
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-235: He forces a laugh, shrugging in mock defeat.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-236: "I tried. Three times. Nothing happened. Perhaps the tree is waiting for another hand."
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-237: He pats the small purse at his belt with a knowing grin.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-238: "Do this for me and I can pay you some coins. A fair trade, isn't it?"
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-239: Choose “Examine the names carved into the bark.”
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-24: Then the presence speaks directly into your thoughts.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-240: You trace the grooves on the bark. The name 'Michael' appears not once, but three times.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-241: "You see? I told you I tried. The tree wouldn't answer me..."
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-242: "You have noticed something strange." (Party member required: Ranger, Available once)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-243: Carve your own name. (Depending on the progression of the story, only once)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-245: You let your gaze linger on the bark a moment longer. The name 'Michael' appears three times, yet the hand behind each carving is different.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-246: Different pressure. Different angle. Different man.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-248: You hesitate a little before pressing steel to bark.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-249: The first stroke bites deeper than it should. Sap seeps slow as the letters take shape.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-25: "What follows every soul beyond death... yet never reaches the grave?"
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-250: As you finish the last letter, a terrible shriek erupts from the tree.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-251: Michael's face twists into cruel delight. He lets out a harsh laugh.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-253: Still laughing, he slips back into the thicket, vanishing from sight.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-254: A ghost appears before you, leaving no chance to pursue Michael.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-255: Choose “Refuse. You won't carve his name.”
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-258: He turns on his heel and slips back into the trees.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-259: Choose “Carve your own name.” (Depends on story progress)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-262: You place your hand on the bark. The whispers surge as your blade carves the letters.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-263: Michael's expression sours. He mutters about fools and wasted chances before slipping back into the undergrowth.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-264: Your name burns across the bark in a surge of living light, as if the tree itself speaks it aloud.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-265: A surge of power rises from the roots and courses through your body. For a moment, you feel stronger than ever before.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-268: You leave the Whispering Tree behind and continue through the forest.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-270: You kneel beside a patch of soft mud. Fresh wolf tracks cut between the roots, almost invisible beneath fallen leaves.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-271: The tracks slip between dense trees where no road should fit.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-276: The stone wolves at Caerlin's feet begin to glow faintly, their eyes filled with pale silver light.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-277: A quiet warmth settles over you.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-278: You feel watched. Judged. Then accepted.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-279: A weathered statue. Headless woman draped in stone furs, two wolves at her feet. Ivy coils up her legs, flowers pushing through the cracks.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-281: The statue stands just as you left it. Silent, watching the clearing with stone-still patience.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-282: Dialogue options (The statue has not been repaired yet)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-284: Place it there The head of the wolf. (Hold it.) Wolf Skull)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-285: "I know fragments of her story..." (Party member required: Wizard, Available once)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-286: "Old blood carries old stories." (Party member required: Blood Mage, Available once)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-289: The statue's neck ends in a clean break. Moss covers much of the stone, but a faint glow seeps through the cracks.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-290: Wolves circle the base. Not pets, but guardians carved for a purpose no time could quite erase.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-291: Choose “I know fragments of her story...”
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-292: Your fingers follow the runes sunk into the moss. "Caerlin, the Wolf Queen," you whisper.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-293: A demi-goddess who loved a mortal hunter. For him, bound wolves and men under one peace.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-294: Her pact held as long as love did.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-296: You study the statue, feeling for old blood beneath old stone.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-297: "There is a less-known version of the tale," you say.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-298: "The hunter broke his vow. The Queen grieved, and the wolves turned on mankind."
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-299: "Not every love story ends as a song."
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-301: You lift the carved wolf-head and set it gently upon the broken neck.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-302: Light spills from the seams in a sudden, blinding flare.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-303: The stone wolves at her feet begin to move, their heads slowly turning toward you. The air around the statue grows warm.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-304: Somewhere nearby, stone grinds. A hidden passage opens.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-305: A heavy iron hunting trap lies there, masked by leaves and pine needles.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-306: Your foot brushes something hidden in the dirt.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-308: Blood seeps between the iron teeth as the trap clamps tight.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-309: The Caerlin Woods rise ahead, pines dripping with rain. The ground is soft, the air cold, each breath tasting of wet earth.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-310: Those who return speak of shadows that move without wind, and of wolves with starving eyes watching from between the trees.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-34: The silhouette slowly dissolves into the mist.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-36: The trees creak softly around you.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-40: A cold ripple passes through the air.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-42: The spirit vanishes between the trees.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-44: The silhouette tilts its head slightly.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-47: Then, slowly, it bows its head.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-49: For a moment, the air turns bitterly cold. A small frost-covered charm slowly appears among the roots before you.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-5: "Follow the scent of blood." (Requires Blood Mage)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-50: The spirit unravels into pale drifting particles, scattering soundlessly into the fog.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-51: For a moment, faint footsteps echo deeper within the forest... then disappear completely.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-52: Event opening (View the dry well for the first time)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-53: An old stone well stands crooked among the roots. The rope rotted away long ago. No bucket. No surface water. Only a black throat dropping into the earth. What are you going to do?
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-54: Event opening (The dry well has been checked)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-55: The old well waits among the roots where you left it.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-58: Toss a coin into the shaft.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-61: Cold air rises from below. The stone lining continues straight for a long way. Far beneath, something faintly glimmers... maybe water... maybe just a wet rock.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-62: Choose “Drop a stone and listen.” (With Rock)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-63: You heft a small stone over the mouth and let go. It clatters hard against the walls, strikes something below, then... silence.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-64: You heft a stone and let it fall. It rattles into the depths and fades away.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-65: Choose “Drop a stone and listen.” (Depends on story progress)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-66: After a moment, you hear a soft skittering scraping its way upward.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-67: Choose “Drop a stone and listen.” (Without Rock)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-68: You nudge a few chips of stone into the shaft. They patter down and vanish. The echo returns late and faint. The well is deep, but there is no splash.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-69: Select “Toss a coin into the shaft” / “Toss a coin into the shaft” (Have at least 1 gold coin)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-70: The coin rings off the inner wall and spirals into the dark. From below, a long, hungry whisper rises.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-72: Toss a coin into the shaft
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-73: Choose “Toss a coin into the shaft” (Have at least 1 gold coin)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-74: Again it falls, clinking down the stone throat. The voice returns, sharper now.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-76: Your offering vanishes. The dark breathes back the same word, again and again.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-78: "This voice isn't hunger. I can feel the void." (Party member required: Voidcaller, Available once)
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-79: Choose “This voice isn't hunger. I can feel the void.”
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-8: You crouch low, brushing wet grit aside.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-80: "You can't feed void. Let it starve."
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-81: The echo wavers strangely, as though something deep below had just exhaled.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-83: Something grates far below. Iron on stone, then a hush.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-85: A series of tiny taps echoes up from the darkness.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-87: The coin rattles into the dark. A faint breath rises from below.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-89: Cold air tugs outward, as if the well were swallowing.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-9: "Human boots," you say. "Quite old. They favor the western cave."
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-90: The coin disappears into the depths. The answer comes immediately.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-91: "YES. THAT ONE. MORE LIKE THAT ONE."
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-92: A long silence follows. Then a thoughtful murmur rises from below.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-96: The coin tumbles into the darkness.
maps.points.caerlin_woods.dialogue-98: A distant clink echoes from below.

maps.points.caerlin_woods.f24.detail: Examine the dry well at (1, -40). You need a stone the first time you choose “Drop a stone and listen.”
maps.points.caerlin_woods.f45.detail: At the forest altar (20, -21), empty either cup, add water, food or 1 or 5 gold coins to the golden cup, drink from it, or drink from the glowing cup without first offering 10 gold coins.
